name: Unerring Critical (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at landing just the right blow against just the right enemy.

Prerequisite: Critical Focus, base attack bonus +9

Benefit: When using a critical hit chart or a critical hit deck to determine random effects of a critical hit, roll twice on the chart or draw two cards and pick one of the two results.
